office_does: The prosecuting attorney charges and prosecutes crimes in Clallam County and is the county's civil lawyer.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Mark Nichols, prosecuting attorney since his election in 2014, is seeking a fourth term with no opponent.

candidates.summary: Clallam County Prosecuting Attorney since his election in 2014 and a former park ranger and deputy prosecutor, seeking a fourth term focused on violent and repeat offenders and victims' rights.
highlights: Says public safety remains his top priority, with focus on violent offenders and repeat offenders [S1]
Helped stand up a mental health court now run by District Court 1 [S3]
Criticized proposed bail-rule changes and unfunded public-defense caseload limits [S4]
Publishes quarterly prosecutor data and wants a case dashboard [S3]
